newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bayer optimistic about Mexico outlook.
newsitem.headline: Bayer optimistic about Mexico outlook.

text.p: German chemical and pharmaceuticals group Bayer AG said it would invest about 190 million marks in its Mexican operations by the year 2000.
Bayer management board member Walter Wenninger, in a news conference held on Tuesday in Mexico City, said Bayer was committed to Mexico despite political turbulence in the country in recent years.

"Thanks to the open-door policy which has been pursued consistently over the last few years, we can expect the Mexican economy to receive a further boost," Wenninger said. A copy of his speech was made available in Germany.
